opening.argument: The material presents a Panera Bread gift card as an ordinary product available for online purchase. The title expressly says “Buy Panera Bread Gift Card online,” while the video visibly displays a $25 Panera Bread gift card and instructs viewers to click the link in the description. The description supplies that external link, and the on-screen text says “Find the best price for this product,” framing the action as routine price-finding rather than a deceptive promise. Nothing presented requests payment or private data, and there is no conflicting product or offer. The observable presentation is therefore conventional commerce promotion.
